verdict_evidence_summary: Set-membership counterexample distinguishes 5 in Omega from {5} subset Omega; fidelity independently confirms the same source/book notation.

verdict_evidence_summary: One-way implications do not characterize union, intersection, or complement; both reviews identify the missing converse.
evidence_gate: reproducible finite-set counterexample
remediation_disposition: Use iff in each membership characterization.

verdict_evidence_summary: The assertion that no probability can be defined on every subset of R is refuted by the Dirac measure on 2^R; fidelity independently confirms the unqualified source claim.
evidence_gate: reproducible Dirac-measure counterexample
remediation_disposition: Qualify the nonmeasurability statement by the needed Lebesgue/invariance requirements.

verdict_evidence_summary: Tensor-product notation is not the stated Cartesian product and the event builder leaves omega unbound; fidelity verifies both defects.
evidence_gate: type check and confirmed fidelity verdict
remediation_disposition: Use product_i Omega_i and bind omega in Omega in A_i.

verdict_evidence_summary: A sample space and sigma-algebra do not fix P(A); constant and alternating history measures give 1 and 0. Fidelity finds no formal iid model in the source.
fidelity_status: source has only an informal fairness aside
evidence_gate: reproducible two-measure counterexample
remediation_disposition: State iid uniform draws before qualitative or numerical probability conclusions.

verdict_evidence_summary: Two cited contemporary reports identify the event as Toto 2 6/42 with 18 winners; the resulting N and adjacent-repeat probability differ from the book's 6/49/14 model.

remediation_disposition: Correct the game, winner count, N, and derived probability, or label 6/49 as hypothetical.

verdict_evidence_summary: Brownian continuity, nowhere differentiability, and infinite length are probability-one properties, not literal properties of every path-space element.
evidence_gate: standard path-property distinction stated in fidelity review
remediation_disposition: Add an almost-sure/probability-one qualifier.

verdict_evidence_summary: The book strengthens a caveated base-rate illustration into an effectiveness assertion without denominators, date, composition, or causal model.
evidence_gate: transcript-to-book comparison plus missing-data analysis

verdict_evidence_summary: Normalized weights alone omit 2^Omega and P(A)=sum_{i in A}p_i; fidelity confirms the source supplied the general-event construction.

remediation_disposition: Add event sigma-algebra, general-event formula, and brief countable-additivity justification.

verdict_evidence_summary: Every-subset language permits nonmeasurable A and finite volume permits |Omega|=0; fidelity shows the source explicitly warned about a sigma-algebra.
evidence_gate: Vitali-set and zero-volume counterexamples, independently confirmed
remediation_disposition: Require measurable Omega, 0<|Omega|<infinity, and measurable events.

verdict_evidence_summary: Displayed ratios use zero-allowed conditioning events/atoms. Concrete m1=m2=0, P(A)=1, and impossible-atom cases yield 0/0; the appendix repeats unqualified point conditioning.

evidence_gate: multiple reproducible zero-denominator counterexamples and fidelity confirmations
remediation_disposition: Restrict elementary conditioning to positive-probability events/atoms and state a version/a.e. convention for point conditioning.

verdict_evidence_summary: The hospital example omits the lecturer's mutually-exclusive and exhaustive disease-class caveat; overlapping diseases double-count probability.
evidence_gate: overlap counterexample plus transcript evidence
remediation_disposition: State a mutually exclusive exhaustive diagnostic partition, including an other class as needed.

verdict_evidence_summary: Null-event conditioning is treated as a universal pointwise limit/value; exponential sums satisfy P(S_n=t)=0. The robust statement is an a.s. conditional-expectation identity or a specified regular conditional version.
evidence_gate: reproducible continuous-null-event example and cross-book corroboration
remediation_disposition: Use E[X_1|S_n]=S_n/n a.s. under integrability; qualify pointwise formulas by a regular conditional version.

verdict_evidence_summary: P(Y=0)=0 does not make X/Y a total R-valued map; a two-point space with a null zero-denominator outcome gives an undefined value.

evidence_gate: reproducible two-point counterexample plus fidelity confirmation
remediation_disposition: Require no zero values or define a measurable null-set modification and state a.s. equality.

verdict_evidence_summary: Finite linear-closure does not prove a countable partition sum measurable; {X<b}=union_{j:x_j<b}H_j supplies the missing proof.
evidence_gate: direct preimage proof and confirmed fidelity verdict
remediation_disposition: Replace the finite-linear-combination rationale with the countable-union preimage argument.

verdict_evidence_summary: A nonempty partition cell can have probability zero, so strict p_j>0 conflicts with the stated all-possible-values construction unless a positive-mass support convention is introduced.
evidence_gate: Lebesgue null-cell construction

verdict_evidence_summary: Checking only one enumerated support can miss a Y-only atom; identical tables require every real x or the union of supports.
evidence_gate: explicit unequal-support counterexample
remediation_disposition: Quantify P_X(X=x)=P_Y(Y=x) over every x in R.

verdict_evidence_summary: Finite mean does not ensure finite squared loss; p_j proportional to j^-3 gives finite EX but infinite loss for every a. The book also removes a source hedge.
evidence_gate: reproducible p-series counterexample plus independent fidelity evidence

verdict_evidence_summary: The notes define E[X] only as finite, yet assert a tail identity for every nonnegative integer-valued X; a normalized 1/(k log^2 k) law diverges.

verdict_evidence_summary: Fair marginals alone permit dependent signs whose sum is always zero, refuting the stated variance and asymptotic claim.

verdict_evidence_summary: Independence is sufficient, not necessary: dependent uncorrelated X and X^2 give additivity.

verdict_evidence_summary: The variance identity can contain infinite endpoint derivatives or infinity-minus-infinity under the stated domain; fidelity independently gives heavy-tail examples.

verdict_evidence_summary: Wald/total-variance formulas are presented under assumptions allowing infinite first or second moments; the supplement is book-added.

verdict_evidence_summary: Integral (n+1)p and integral lambda create two modes; p=1 also sends the printed binomial floor outside support. The appendix repeats the defect.

verdict_evidence_summary: At p=0 the waiting time is not finite; at p=1 later memoryless conditioning is 0/0. Cross-book tables omit domains.

verdict_evidence_summary: n=100,p=.2 meets the advertised rule but yields material Bin/Poi errors, including a factor about 10 at k=0.

verdict_evidence_summary: The admitted N=M=n=1 case makes N-1 zero although the variance is 0.

verdict_evidence_summary: rho is undefined for constants, while lecture theorems and the appendix use it under finite-only/unqualified hypotheses; equality is a.s., not pointwise.

category: fixed-value conditional expectation and supplemental correlations

verdict_evidence_summary: Degenerate fixed counts make correlation undefined and the finite-population factor equals 1 at n=1.
